player.title: Playback
player.sub: Instructions for venue screens, iPad kiosks, and course presentations

blocks.title: Venue screen
steps: Open the marketing hub in a browser and sign in
Open “Screen Player”
Press F11 for browser fullscreen
Space pauses / resumes; use ← → to change slides
Set this site as the browser home page for startup playback

blocks.title: iPad kiosk
steps: Open the site in Safari and sign in
Share → “Add to Home Screen”
Launch fullscreen from the Home Screen icon
Use Guided Access to lock the app and prevent accidental exits

blocks.title: Course walkthrough (for parents)
steps: Open the “Courses” page
Select “Presentation mode”
Use ← → or Space to change slides; press Esc to exit
Use ?slide=N to open a specific slide

ops.title: Operations
ops.sub: Daily material and account maintenance for central operations

blocks.title: Upload material
steps: Sign in with an admin account
Open “Admin → Resources”
Choose a file, fill in the title / category / usage advice, and upload
CJK filenames are preserved; confirm before overwriting an existing name

blocks.title: Publishing and metadata
steps: Use the switch on the resource list to publish or unpublish
Unpublished resources disappear immediately and download links return 404
Use the pencil icon to edit title / category / usage advice / order

blocks.title: Account management
steps: Open “Admin → Accounts” to create an account (username + name + role + initial password)
Use “Reset password” if someone forgets their password
A suspended account cannot sign in until it is restored

blocks.title: Course content changes
steps: Course copy, FAQ, and growth-system content are maintained in the code repository
Work with the technical team to update and publish through git
